content: The abstract introduces a novel methodology for performing feature selection and classification of functional data with categorical responses and longitudinal features. The proposed approach integrates logistic loss and functional features to identify the most crucial features for classification, and utilizes functional principal components and an adaptive version of the Dual Augmented Lagrangian algorithm to address the optimization problem efficiently, enabling the method to handle high-dimensional scenarios.
